subject: Special Education Reserve Fund and Staff Retirements
overview: The School Committee celebrated numerous student achievements and staff retirements, including a $50,000 donation from Tufts University to the Medford Family Network. Key business items included establishing a Special Education Reserve Fund and approving an amended 2026-2027 school calendar.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss collective bargaining with the MTA and Teamsters Local 25, and contract negotiations for non-union personnel.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine items including payroll, meeting minutes from May 18, and a donation to the McGlynn Library.

items.title: Mustang Moments and Student Recognitions
items.summary: Recognized student achievements in the Medford Children's Art Showcase, the state champion eSports Mario Kart team, and participants in humanities programs including Mock Trial and Model UN.

items.title: Recognition of CPAC Retirements
items.summary: Honored retiring members of the Special Education Parent Advisory Council executive board for a decade of service and advocacy.

items.title: District Retirements and Employee Anniversaries
items.summary: Celebrated fifteen retiring staff members and recognized long-serving employees with up to 40 years of service in the district.

items.title: Medford Family Network Retirement and Tufts Donation
items.summary: Honored retiring Medford Family Network founder Marie Cassidy and approved a $50,000 donation from Tufts University dedicated to the network.

items.title: 2026-2027 District Calendar Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amended calendar for the 2026-2027 school year that designates Good Friday as a day off by redistributing professional development hours.

items.title: District Handbook Updates
items.summary: Tabled the updated district handbooks to allow for revisions regarding elementary recess protections, AI grading policies, and bus surveillance notifications.

items.title: Policy JJH: Student Travel
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an update to student travel policy to streamline approvals for national competitions occurring between committee meetings.

items.title: Resolution to Establish Special Education Reserve Fund
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2026-13 as amended to establish a reserve fund for unanticipated special education costs, capped at 2% of annual expenditures.

items.title: Moment of Silence for Maureen Hennigan
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for Maureen Hennigan, a 28-year veteran of the Medford Public Schools.
